threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You ask for directions to the tube and people look at you like you just asked for a time machine. It's all about the bus routes, mate.
Caught a lad serenading the driver on the 21 late last night. He was convinced it was an open mic, but only the 3am crowd showed up.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a cat on a leash casually strutting past a kebab stand while the owner sipped coffee at 8 AM. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a late-night Döner while an impromptu drum circle plays on the street. The vibe is unbeatable.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a local would know to avoid BART during rush hour, especially after they delayed trains for brake issues. It’s chaos! Visitors just stand clueless.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo on the 31 Balboa this morning, juggling oranges. Only in SF can you blend glamour and chaos at 8 AM.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into a bar and get a table during happy hour. Locals know it’s stand at the bar or wait for a spot—no reservations here.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they’re still using Google Maps to navigate the Metro. Locals know it’s easier to just follow the crowds.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'the Tube' like it's your lifeline. Real locals know it’s a last resort — bike or bus is where it's at.
Caught a night bus last week and overheard a couple arguing over whether to have Jollof or fried chicken for dinner. Best entertainment after a long shift!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a group of kids trading Pokémon cards at the bus stop while a street musician played an unforgettable version of ‘Wonderwall’.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how the U-Bahn stations here have those old, ornate tile murals? It’s like a secret art gallery underground, reflects the city's gritty charm.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they react to the BART delays—rolling eyes and a knowing smirk, while newcomers just stare at their phones.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling on the bus while the driver argued with a route map. Classic San Francisco chaos—only here does confusion become a show.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals enjoy the beach, but you’ll find most of us prefer the terrace bars and shady plazas in Gràcia over the packed sands.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their reluctance to negotiate prices at the market; the locals know it's all part of the game.
